query: How will we construct the novel-error held-out set to ensure true OOD errors and prevent contamination from synthetic-generation processes or label leakage?

response.query: How will we construct the novel-error held-out set to ensure true OOD errors and prevent contamination from synthetic-generation processes or label leakage?
response.answer: To construct the novel-error held-out set, use data not involved in model training or synthetic generation. Ensure no label leakage by keeping it completely separate. Validate with independent data to confirm true out-of-distribution errors.
